channel.title: Togo - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Togo, every source cited.

item.title: Lokossa school denies viral video rumour
item.description: The CEG 3 administration stated that the named student is not registered and no such incident occurred.

item.title: Togo and Russia boost sambo with new partnership
item.description: The sport, originating in the USSR, is gaining a foothold in West Africa through a sports cooperation agreement.

item.title: African consumers urge zero added sugar for young children
item.description: The African Consumers Organisation (OAC) wants African nations to back a ban on added sugars in baby food.

item.title: Togo journalist's judicial control challenged
item.description: The African Free Press Union demands an end to restrictions on journalist Apollinaire Mèwènèmesse, imposed over two years ago.

item.title: Togo party welcomes ECOWAS court letter on constitutional order
item.description: The Santé du Peuple party urged a swift return to the 1992 constitution, rejecting academic discussions.
